owner: P0-T (toolchain). Check coverage is owned by P0-T; each entry's file CONTENT belongs to the module owner listed on the entry.
enforcedBy: node scripts/check-pi861-entries.mjs (wired into npm run check as check:pi861-entries)
purpose: Every production entry of extensions/pi861 must be covered by lint (root biome.json), type checking (extension tsconfigs + root tsconfig), and an actual startup path (CI job or documented operator command). Removing an entry's coverage from any config must fail npm run check.

type: root tsconfig.json (tsgo via npm run check)
entries.startup: CI pi-host matrix (published+source x linux+windows) runs test/pi-host.integration.mjs + test/runtime-host.integration.mjs against the real Pi CLI with a deterministic local provider; test/host-install.integration.mjs guards duplicate install. With PI861_REQUIRE_HOST_TESTS=1 and no host resolvable, the tests throw instead of skipping.

type: root tsconfig.json (tsgo via npm run check)
entries.startup: Loaded by the CI pi-host matrix through runtime.ts and by extensions/pi861/examples/postgres-extension.mjs; installPi861 is the single composition surface.

Operator command: node extensions/pi861/scripts/run-acceptance.mjs ABSOLUTE_CONFIG [ABSOLUTE_REPORT_JSON]. Default-closed: refuses non-absolute paths and exits 1 without a trusted config; P1-Q owns the runner contract.

Default-closed: without PI861_REAL_MODEL_ACCEPTANCE=1 the script performs zero requests and reports status=deferred with exit 0 (runner ran; deferred is never a pass). Real-service execution stays behind explicit authorization (K10).

Default-closed: without PI861_REAL_SEARCH_ACCEPTANCE=1 the script performs zero requests and reports status=deferred with exit 0 (runner ran; deferred is never a pass). Real-service execution stays behind explicit authorization (K10).
Default-closed: without PI861_REAL_MCP_ACCEPTANCE=1 the script must exit non-zero and contact nothing. Real-service execution stays behind explicit authorization (K10).

Operator composition example: install pg in a separate operator-owned extension directory (runtime import stays operator-side; only its TYPES are verified here via the pinned root @types/pg devDependency) and start Pi with this extension. No automatic startup: it is type- and lint-checked only, which is its acceptance correspondence.
